notes.title: Playtest 7th Patch note
notes.content:
Volume slider reset bug fixed

Boss health bars more visible

Some movement sounds for tower golem and holy knights fixed

Some 3 rune towers firing rate reduced

notes.title: Playtest 6th Patch note
notes.content:
Day timer now pauses during the 1st day on a new level until you take action.

New enemy death vfx

HUD enemy spawn icons now have additional + symbols when a mixed spawn is coming

Codex bugs rectified

Wizard's auto projectiles no longer whiff targets

Reduced Holy Knights AOE damage

Reduce Bone Wall's Health.

Pause Icon near day timer shown when game is paused

Hundreds of thousands of enemies have been defeated during this playtest so far. Keep on slayin'!

notes.title: Playtest 5th Patch Note
notes.content:
Changed volume sliders to logarithmic.

Tier 2 Archers population cost corrected to 4.

Drafting building upgrades with existing buildings will no longer negatively affect population.

Some text fonts enlarged.

Build screens and Upgrade screens can no longer be opened simulataneously.

Fixed some double tap UI issues.  



Thank you for all the feedback helping make the game all it can be!

notes.title: Public Playtest is NOW OPEN
notes.content:
Public Playtest
Today kicks off the first public playtest for Castillon! Anyone who had previously registered for the playtest will now automatically be granted access. Anyone new simply needs to click the green "Join The Playtest" button the the game's store page.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/83855e161bcb4b76074062b70831c1d9890d434d.png"]

A lot of work has gone into the project this year, finding what we hope to be a unique blend of genres. We've taken the basics of TD, RTS and Base Builder games and boiled them down into a tight strategy experience. This playtest will grant you access to the Tutorial and first 2 playable levels.


[previewyoutube="I6Av0pUxm2w;full"][/previewyoutube]Feedback?
We have a number of ways for you to provide feedback. Please use whichever feels most compatible with your own preferences. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to do so, and are eager to improve the game based on your response!



Steam Discussions - Easy to access, and perfect if you just want to brain-dump your thoughts

Google Form - Helps guide you with simple questions. Completely anonymous

Discord - If you prefer something more conversational, you can chat directly with the devs


Thank You!
We can't thank you enough for your interest in our game, and for taking the time to share your thoughts. If we could ask on more favour of you, it'd be that you please add Castillon to your Wishlist!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483570/Castillon/"][/dynamiclink]We hope everyone has a great weekend! And we can't wait to read through all your feedback.
Cheers!

notes.title: Sign-up for the upcoming Playtest!
notes.content:
PLAYTEST

Castillon development is going strong, and the game has been taking shape rapidly. After some more time is spent implementing and polishing a few new features, we are planning to run public playtest! Your feedback would be greatly appreciated, and will help steer the final direction for Castillon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/8d0dd713cc96d05c6987b70b8a438039377a11b8.png"]

On the main Steam page, directly below the screenshots, there is a button to Request Access to Join the Playtest. This will add you to our playtesting list. And when it is time to test the upcoming beta, you will be notified directly through Steam!


WHAT'S NEW?NEW UI
The most recent changes have been on improving the UI, looking to keep things simple and clean, while functional and informative.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/3658e3dbc33d6169656ea2d499dbd33e90b52d79.png"]

Menus now have a simpler presentation, and much more clearly delineated buttons. The resource UI has all been consolidated. The Day/Night cycles + Enemy Wave trackers have been brought together as a part of the mini-map to give you a quick overview. And a Wizard-specific display has been added to better track your hero's health and abilities.


IMPROVED TOWERS
The Towercrafting system continue to improve!
With 4 elemental gems, there are a total of 34 unique towers your can build to enhance your defenses!

Here is a quick look at the Tier 1 and 2 towers, showing how Holy, Necro, Arcane and Engineering gems have be paired off.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/69a6fe9793d9d31a4a9b4af6c4bbca3364aaa2ec.jpg"]

While this system is designed to allow for Towers at all Tiers to be useful contributors to your defenses - it is Tier 3 where the real strength is found! These towers can deal devastating damage, greatly enhance your units, hinder enemies, and otherwise turn the tide of battle in your favor.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452032/c136064518465a01e2f5ea93a7240e403ad89c54.jpg"]

We're very excited for you to see it all in action!
Don't forgot to sign up for the playtest so you can be notified as soon as that's ready for participants. Thanks!

notes.title: Highscore system update
notes.content:
Following ever helpful feedback, we've added a clearer scoring system at the end of a win. There are also some lovely quality of life issues we're tackling such as the building placement controls and the ever expanding waves of enemies tweaking.

Stay tunes for more updates as we continue to develop Castillon!
